title: daemonsudo gate.yaml — the sudoers file for your agents

defaults.description: Action when no rule matches a tool name. 'approve' is safe-by-default.

timeout.description: How long a pending approval waits before it is denied. Number = seconds, or a string like '30s', '10m', '1h'.

rules.description: Glob on tool name → action. Most-specific glob wins, then file order.

redact.description: Arg paths (globs, e.g. '*.password') whose values are replaced with [redacted] in receipts and approval cards. Full args are only ever stored as a hash.

telemetry.description: Opt-in weekly ping of {version, anon_id}. Default off.

max_ttl.description: Clamp for approve-with-grant TTLs (e.g. '8h'). Session grants live for the gate/daemon process lifetime.

listen.description: Optional second listener serving ONLY /health (tokenless) + token-authed /gate/* — bind it to a docker bridge for split topology. Operator pages never appear here. FATAL if it cannot bind.

url.description: Remote-broker mode: the host daemon's gate URL. The proxy holds no policy/keys/ledger; daemon unreachable = everything fails closed, auto included. Env DAEMONSUDO_REMOTE_URL wins.
Off-box checkpoint receiver (daemonsudo mirror --listen). Signed head checkpoints stream here; verify --against detects truncation/rewrite.

token_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the mirror bearer token.
Name of the environment variable holding the bot token (never the token itself).

allowed_users.description: Telegram user IDs allowed to approve.

token_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the bot token (never the token itself).

allowed_users.description: Discord user IDs (snowflakes) allowed to approve — STRINGS, they exceed 2^53.

host.description: Bind address. Keep it on localhost unless you know what you are doing.
